product_one_liner.value: Trusaic provides enterprises with software to analyze and remediate pay inequities, guide compensation decisions, and meet pay-transparency reporting requirements.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the navigation or footer; the pricing URL returned no readable page. The site directs prospects to sales and demo scheduling.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in the homepage's customer advisory-board logo section.

employee_band.notes: The available company record reports 122 employees.

founded_year.notes: Trusaic dates its foundation to 2014; its predecessor, First Capitol Consulting, was founded in 1999.

eng_blog.notes: The index primarily contains compliance commentary and product content, not at least two engineer-authored product-build posts.

public_docs.notes: No public product-docs, developer, or help-center link appears in the navigation or footer. The site instead links to resources and customer login portals; the docs and help subdomains returned no readable content.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A careers page and job-listing page exist, but the accessible listing content exposed neither current role titles nor an explicit no-openings statement, preventing a supported determination.

model_provider.notes: The AI product and responsible-AI FAQs, technical overview blog post, trust center, and subprocessor disclosures did not identify an underlying model or model provider. Microsoft Azure is identified as a hosting provider, not an AI-model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The homepage claims SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 certification, and GDPR compliance; GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: The funding database records no rounds, and the company overview does not disclose outside funding; 'none' means no known outside funding.

raised_18mo.notes: No known outside funding rounds are recorded.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Search results surfaced SDR and account-executive listings, but their current live status was not verified. The company's accessible job-listing content did not expose current titles.

launched_6mo.notes: On May 20, 2026, Trusaic introduced an enhanced EU Pay Transparency Directive Transposition Monitor with interactive country-level legislative tracking, jurisdiction-specific updates, and projected effective dates.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The leadership biographies and announcements reviewed did not establish dated C-level or VP arrivals or departures within the requested window; undated biographies cannot establish a negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The page uses HubSpot Meetings links for demo scheduling; this signal does not establish a full HubSpot CRM deployment.
